thread:
maya: quick heads up — CloudScale asked us to provision a HK region offering as a hybrid marketplace SKU for pilot customers. They need quota + KMS routing confirmation by Friday EOD. :eyes:
sam: timeline? do they want dedicated GPUs or shared ded? any SKU ids yet?
maya: partner wants a small committed pool to start (8 A100 equivalent). they listed marketplace SKU placeholder: MARKETPLACE-HK-HYBRID-01 — vendor said it needs entitlement approval and quota bump.
leo: ops question — are we routing keys through our KMS or theirs for the marketplace integration? legal needs that to sign the MOU.
toni: we need to see the KMS flow and a data residency diagram. if keys are customer-owned in their KMS, legal's ok faster. if we manage keys we need review (SOC2/CSF appendix).
maya: partner prefers customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own) but will accept us as the managed option for the pilot if we sign the SLA addendum. I'll push for BYOK.
sam: for quota escalation I can submit the marketplace entitlement request. need exact quotas: GPUs, vCPUs, and bandwidth. can someone confirm vCPU baseline?
leo: recommend starting with 8 gpus, 64 vCPU baseline for control plane, 10TB egress cap for month 1. we can scale with autoscaler but need the quota pre-approved to avoid launch cold-start.
ops-bot: deploy-ticket created: #DSK-4982 — entitlement request + KMS diagram (assignee: leo). ETA: 2026-03-28.
maya: linking the partner doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/HK-marketplace-provisioning (internal). please add comments with approvals.
toni: I'll review the MOU draft today. if BYOK, legal notes: add section 4.2 for key rotation responsibilities and section 7 for breach notification timelines.
sam: should I route the entitlement to CloudScale CSM or their Marketplace Ops? partner contact is @anna (CloudScale). who will intro?
maya: I'll intro now and cc anna + legal. quick ask for everyone: reply with either "+1" to proceed with the BYOK pilot or "need changes" and short reason. goal: lock QC/quotas by Fri so partner can start marketplace listing next week. :rocket:
leo: +1
toni: +1 (pending minor MOU tweak — will post comment)
sam: +1, will draft entitlement request once I get the vCPU confirm from leo
maya: thanks — I'll start the intro thread and attach ops-bot ticket. ping me if anything blocks.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: entitlement review sync on 2026-03-27 10:00 PDT (calendar invite sent).
